title: Panda dancing
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='68' rx='20' ry='22' fill='#E8EEF7'/>
  <!-- belly -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='72' rx='13' ry='14' fill='#C8D4E6'/>
  <!-- left leg dancing up -->
  <ellipse cx='34' cy='86' rx='9' ry='7' fill='#6B5B8A' transform='rotate(-25 34 86)'/>
  <!-- right leg dancing out -->
  <ellipse cx='68' cy='85' rx='9' ry='7' fill='#6B5B8A' transform='rotate(20 68 85)'/>
  <!-- left arm up -->
  <ellipse cx='28' cy='56' rx='7' ry='10' fill='#6B5B8A' transform='rotate(-40 28 56)'/>
  <!-- right arm out -->
  <ellipse cx='74' cy='58' rx='7' ry='10' fill='#6B5B8A' transform='rotate(45 74 58)'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='38' r='20' fill='#E8EEF7'/>
  <!-- left ear -->
  <circle cx='34' cy='22' r='8' fill='#6B5B8A'/>
  <!-- right ear -->
  <circle cx='66' cy='22' r='8' fill='#6B5B8A'/>
  <!-- eye patches -->
  <ellipse cx='42' cy='36' rx='7' ry='8' fill='#6B5B8A' transform='rotate(-10 42 36)'/>
  <ellipse cx='58' cy='36' rx='7' ry='8' fill='#6B5B8A' transform='rotate(10 58 36)'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='43' cy='35' r='3' fill='#E8EEF7'/>
  <circle cx='57' cy='35' r='3' fill='#E8EEF7'/>
  <!-- nose -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='45' rx='4' ry='3' fill='#9B8FC0'/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M44 49 Q50 54 56 49' stroke='#9B8FC0' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- little dance motion lines -->
  <path d='M20 40 Q16 44 20 48' stroke='#FFD966' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M80 40 Q84 44 80 48' stroke='#FFD966' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M30 18 Q34 14 38 18' stroke='#FFD966' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M62 18 Q66 14 70 18' stroke='#FFD966' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
</svg>
